title: Plugin checkSettings and checkSecret calls and their result envelopes had no exception boundary, so a thrown message could reach a 500 answer
resolution: Both checks run inside the plugin envelope reader shared with the binding service; a throw, a throwing getter, or a bad envelope is a sanitized internal failure and one scm.plugin.defect record, with service and HTTP tests.

title: A plugin-controlled details.setting was copied into the public failure, so a setting value or free text could be quoted
resolution: A reported setting is kept only when the request or the integration holds that name, otherwise settings; tests cover a value, free text, no name, and malformed details.

title: The in-memory store published the audit row before the integration, so a reader between them saw one without the other
resolution: The in-memory audit stages the row and the store publishes it with the integration in one synchronous step; a test reads both after every microtask of a create and an update.

title: The PostgreSQL retry tests did not show that an attempt which appended its audit row leaves no duplicate after the retry
resolution: The gated race asserts the audit rows, and a new test loses a serialization race after the append and expects one row; an append in a second transaction fails it.

title: The record called the 20f plugin boundary follow-up done while webhook verification still built the provider with revealed secrets outside any boundary
resolution: The stored verifiers build the provider inside the shared plugin boundary; a defect is one createProvider record and the one 401; the record lists the plugin calls still outside it.

title: Design and record still said the in-memory row is appended before the integration is kept
resolution: Both now say the row is staged, then published with the integration in one synchronous step.

title: The PostgreSQL store kept a branch for a refused append that the transaction records never answer
resolution: The transaction records fail only by throwing and answer no result; the port adapter wraps them, and the store has no dead branch.

title: A create missing a required setting answers settings instead of the setting name, since the plugin port declares no setting names
resolution: Kept by a coordinator decision in design.md; adding settingNames to the plugin port touches every plugin and is a follow-up.

title: The plugin identifier, its secret names, and the registry lookup were read outside the plugin boundary
resolution: Both members are read once inside the boundary into plain values; a defect is a descriptor record, with a placeholder plugin when the identifier cannot be read; the registry reads the identifier at registration.

title: A refused create logs a defect naming an integration identifier that is never stored
resolution: Wire contracts section 4 states that a create's defect record names the minted identifier, which a refused create never stores.

title: The audit trail read has no filter or page, which the design did not state
resolution: design.md decision 13 states that the port gains a filter by integration and a page when an operation reads the trail.

title: The in-memory snapshot test would hang instead of failing on a write that waits on a macrotask
resolution: The loop fails after 10000 microtasks; a probe write on a timer hangs without the cap and fails at once with it.

title: The checks table lacked the make verify run after the pass 1 fixes
resolution: The table names run 3 with its revision, tree, and totals.
